newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Croatia set to back Yugoslav pact in days - Granic.
newsitem.headline: Croatia set to back Yugoslav pact in days - Granic.

text.p: Croatian Foreign Minister Mate Granic, visiting Moscow on Tuesday, said the Zagreb parliament was likely to ratify agreements normalising relations with rump Yugoslavia later this week.

Granic said after talks with Russian Foreign Minister Yevgeny Primakov that a bill to lift economic sanctions against Serbia and amnesty all those, other than war criminals, involved in ethnic conflict in the former Yugoslav republic would be presented to parliament on Wednesday.
"The draft law will be presented to parliament tomorrow and I hope that by Friday it will be approved using a simplified procedure," Granic told a news conference.
Croatia and Yugoslavia, which fought a war when Zagreb declared independence five years ago, recognised each other on August 23 and established diplomatic relations on September 9.
